reuse.why: The tree has the same worst-case rule copied in api-models.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts. The diff edits only the inline copy in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and does not take the chance to pull the rule into one shared function.

duplication.why: It adds no new copy, but it changes one of four existing copies, so the copies now disagree instead of being consolidated.

placement.why: The rule stays as a nested ternary inside the preview function in shared/schedules.ts, rather than in a named amount helper that the forecast, API and template paths could also call.

scope.why: A minimal edit to the one expression plus tests.

maintainability.why: The rule is now inconsistent across preview, forecast, API expectedAmount and budget templates. A maintainer has to know about the other three copies, and `+ -getApproxNumberThreshold(...)` reads awkwardly.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared worst-case helper exists in the tree to go around; getScheduledAmount averages ranges and is a different rule.

disguised_duplication.where: No new duplicated logic is introduced.
